_doc: Clips cut from media/*.mp4 for the Field Manual (game/scripts/ui/field_manual*.gd) by tools/video/cut_tutorial_clips.py, into game/assets/tutorial/<id>.ogv.

def_overview.note: the garrison holding a gun deck

rifle_view.note: a deck rifleman's view (sneaking lionesses come up the field)

rifle_flash.note: a rifleman blinded by a Kangaroo's flash grenade

sentry_gun.note: the Orbital Sentry Gun: crewed, sweeping, firing, barrels glowing

cannon.note: the Arctic Sentinel Cannon: crewed, recoil, lobbed shells

gunner_solo.note: a lone Heavy Gunner: walk, strafe, minigun

gunner_file.note: the squad filing up the spawn ramp and through the tunnel

gunner_wedge.note: out through the blast door into a wedge

gunner_fight.note: a fight on two fronts, the guns overheating

aa_lock.note: locking onto Sky Talons and firing seeking missiles

aa_strike.note: a rocket strike on ground units

aa_auto.note: squads left on their auto orders

flame_fight.note: Chimps rush the squad out of the trees and burn

flame_tree.note: the flame held on a trunk until the canopy catches

flame_clear.note: the CLEAR order burning the forest down

inf_bow.note: low profile: the riflemen ignore her while she looses arrows

inf_op.note: a sabotage operation seen from above

sniper_scope.note: through the scope: shot, bolt, reload

sniper_tags.note: tagged units from the attacker's side

hero_bear.note: The Bear, from the intro's gallery

bear_swim.note: a Bear Rifleman swimming the river

bear_dive.note: the dive: out of the defenders' sight

hippo_raft.note: a Hippo puts its raft down; the riders get off

kangaroo_flash.note: three flash grenades onto the gun deck

kangaroo_raid.note: through the broken gate and up to the decks

ram_raid.note: rams and Chimps loose inside the stronghold

talon_flock.note: a flock, each in a ring of its own

elephant_flak.note: the flak cannons swing up and shoot down the drones

elephant_missiles.note: the RTS view: missiles aimed with O, only as many elephants firing as the kill needs

rhino_cluster.note: the RTS view: three rhinos, F, the cursor on the south gun deck; their bombs walk over it

rhino_aa.note: three rhinos under drones flying in: each locks on and hammers one

hippo_guns.note: two hippos open up on a knot of Flame Troopers, the spray landing round them

hippo_smoke.note: the RTS view: a hippo, R, the cone toward the face; the smoke curtain goes up

drone_swarm.note: a drone swarm off the roof onto a knot of attackers; the bears shoot back
